headline: Iran strikes US site in Bahrain again; Ukraine downs Kerch Bridge span; Nvidia won't bring back Huang

austin.headline: Austin weighs taking over Muny golf course from UT
austin.summary: Under a proposal tied to an anonymous donation to UT, the city would run the course while UT keeps about 200 acres; the council votes Dec. 3 and UT regents must also approve.

texas.headline: Democrats file bills to legalize and tax marijuana in Texas
texas.summary: At least a dozen cannabis bills have been filed, including three legalization proposals, as the hemp market shrinks under new state and federal THC limits.

texas.headline: TCEQ resumes environmental permit reviews for data centers
texas.summary: The state environmental agency restarted reviews after ERCOT finished gathering community-impact input, drawing calls from Public Citizen for commissioners to resign.

texas.headline: Paxton drops appeal backing doctor against Texas Medical Board
texas.summary: The attorney general ended his appeal in support of Dr. Mary Talley Bowden's challenge to an ivermectin-related reprimand, one of several cases he has dropped since losing his Senate race.

texas.headline: Texas Democrats press for an immigration deal before January
texas.summary: Emboldened by midterm gains, Texas Democrats urged Trump and congressional Republicans to negotiate immigration reform now; Trump has called a deal difficult but doable.

us.headline: FAA halts router installs it linked to national ground stop
us.summary: The agency paused new Juniper router installations and disabled installed units after tracing Friday's overload, which hit 17 of 22 air traffic centers, to a router in Arkansas.

us.headline: Peltola leads Sullivan in Alaska Senate race
us.summary: Democrat Mary Peltola is ahead of Republican Sen. Dan Sullivan in the latest Alaska results.

us.headline: US no longer considered measles-free
us.summary: The country has lost its measles elimination status, PBS NewsHour reported in its news wrap.

us.headline: Mullin defends government plane trip to football game
us.summary: The official defended flying on a government aircraft to attend a game in the days after the nationwide ground stop.

us.headline: Schumer and Van Hollen set for Dec. 1 leadership vote
us.summary: Schumer says he has the votes to stay Senate Democratic leader in the secret ballot; about 15 Democrats publicly back him and four back Van Hollen.

australia.headline: Quad unveils defence and minerals deals as Trump praises Albanese
australia.summary: Leaders of Australia, the US, India and Japan announced new defence and critical minerals arrangements, and Albanese has since arrived in China ahead of APEC.

australia.headline: Australia sanctions West Bank settlers
australia.summary: Foreign Minister Penny Wong announced sanctions on three people and four organisations over settlement expansion, citing a rise in settler attacks in October.

australia.headline: Wage growth picks up to 3.5 per cent
australia.summary: Annual wage growth rose to 3.5 per cent, while the ASX fell and Lendlease shares dropped 15 per cent.

australia.headline: WA wins gas reservation carve-out, but Senate fight looms
australia.summary: An amendment would permanently set WA's obligation under the national gas reservation scheme to zero; Labor wants it passed by Thursday but lacks Greens or Coalition support.

australia.headline: Early voting opens in Victoria's state election
australia.summary: Victorians began casting early ballots ahead of the November 28 election, following a leaders' debate light on policy.

ai.headline: Nvidia beats forecasts and rules out Huang's return
ai.summary: Nvidia reported quarterly revenue of $115.8 billion, up 103% from a year earlier, guided to about $130 billion, and its chairman said ousted CEO Jensen Huang will not be reinstated.

ai.headline: Anthropic likely to price IPO above its range, sources say
ai.summary: CNBC reports Anthropic is expected to price its shares above the $70-to-$78 range set for this week's listing.

ai.headline: LeBron James sues startup over AI ad using his likeness
ai.summary: James filed suit against a startup over a viral AI-generated ad he alleges exploited his likeness.

ai.headline: Study measures energy use and emissions of US data centers
ai.summary: PBS NewsHour reported on new research quantifying the power demand and emissions of America's data centers.

tech.headline: Wave of outages hits banks, air travel and Apple
tech.summary: CNBC reports a run of widespread outages affecting banks, air travel, the NSA and Apple.

tech.headline: Voyager 1 reaches one light-day from Earth
tech.summary: NASA's Voyager 1 probe is now far enough away that its signals take a full day to reach Earth.

tech.headline: Trump plan seeks $50 billion air traffic control overhaul
tech.summary: The administration's modernisation request comes as Senate Democrats say only about 400 of more than 3,600 planned new routers have been installed.

world.headline: Iran fires drones at US facility in Bahrain for third time
world.summary: Bahrain said it intercepted drones aimed at a US radar site, with no damage or injuries reported, as Tehran resumed strikes on Gulf neighbours after a two-month lull.

world.headline: Ukraine brings down a span of the Kerch Bridge
world.summary: Ukraine says drones and missiles collapsed an arch and road section of the bridge linking Russia to Crimea; the Kremlin says it will be restored.

world.headline: Xi and Putin meet ahead of planned summit with Trump
world.summary: The Chinese and Russian leaders held talks before a three-way meeting with the US president.

world.headline: Germany and Norway to fund more US air defences for Ukraine
world.summary: Germany will put $300 million toward a US package centred on Patriot interceptors, with Norway also contributing.

world.headline: China and Canada expand tariff relief
world.summary: Beijing and Ottawa widened tariff reductions as both countries' relations with Washington remain strained.

aus-cricket.headline: Dunkley leads Sixers to nine-wicket win over Strikers
aus-cricket.summary: Sophia Dunkley hit 72 off 44 and Ellyse Perry made 45 not out as Sydney chased 125 with five overs to spare after Melie Kerr took 3-23.

aus-cricket.headline: Australia and England meet in Hobart ODI decider
aus-cricket.summary: The series is level at 1-1 heading into the third ODI at Bellerive Oval, with Cooper Connolly settling in at No. 3 behind Travis Head and Mitch Marsh.

warriors.headline: Warriors visit Dallas tonight as both teams try to snap skids
warriors.summary: Golden State and the Mavericks each enter on three-game losing streaks after Golden State's 115-94 loss at New Orleans.

warriors.headline: Curry, Butler, Moody and Williams out; Green questionable
warriors.summary: Draymond Green (elbow) and Al Horford (back) are questionable for Dallas, while Kristaps Porzingis is not with the team.
